tasks.short: Research hearing or balance and report actual findings.

steps.what: Find and check actual hearing/balance research sources, protocol and existing study data
inputs: actual research question and approved protocol
actual published sources and existing study records

steps.what: Conduct or direct actual hearing/balance research and interpret actual findings
inputs: checked actual research context
actual participants, instruments and measured study data
outputs: actual checked research results, limitations and chosen conclusions

steps.what: Draft research findings report from actual results and audiologist-chosen conclusions
inputs: actual checked research results, limitations and chosen conclusions

loop.purpose: Draft variable findings prose from actual verified results
loop.input: actual results and chosen conclusions with limitations
loop.check: Check each finding and uncertainty against actual data; no invented efficacy, causality, citations or omitted limitations
loop.stop: Missing result or two failed checks means manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native report fields first; variable findings prose alone needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Check final findings report, scientific limitations, disclosure scope and actual recipients
inputs: source-linked actual findings report draft
actual checked research results, limitations and chosen conclusions
outputs: checked final findings report and permitted destinations

steps.what: Save checked final hearing/balance findings report
inputs: checked final findings report and permitted destinations

steps.what: Deliver exact checked findings report to actual authorised research or development recipients
inputs: checked final findings report and permitted destinations

tasks.design: Configure native study/source links in {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS}, then draft variable findings prose only from actual checked results. The audiologist retains actual research, interpretation and full final checking before separate save and delivery through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research preparation and findings prose may repeat source navigation and rewriting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and bounded factual drafting can reduce those repetitions.
tasks.still_hard: Research validity and implications for procedures or treatments need scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The audiologist distinguishes a research observation from evidence sufficient to change clinical practice.
tasks.altitude: Less research administration; scientific judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked research views and bounded report drafting can assist administration; they do not conduct hearing research or establish treatment effectiveness.

assumptions: Actual study team/instruments produce observations and primary data during retained s2; audiologist checks quality and chooses conclusions. No data capture, study execution or scientific interpretation is assumed free.

S3 retains 10.5 provisional hours of result clarification/draft checking; s4 retains full scientific and disclosure review. Reports never turn planned experiments into findings. Actual new tables/analysis remain in s2 unless a separately measured repetitive calculation is established.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native functions first; existing reports earn zero saving. Save/send each retain one percent using existing checks. Actual internal recipient uses internal delivery authority; external delivery only where authorised.
unknowns: Which source navigation and findings rewriting repeats?
research_questions: Can drafting reduce prose work after complete scientific checking?

already_counted.description: Result clarification and draft checking retained in s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual study links and test faithful findings drafting.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final findings report and exact research-record destination; edits require recheck
s4 exact final findings report, disclosure scope and authorised recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 source navigation + 15*0.30 prose = 10.5; minus 1.5 upkeep = 9. Half eligible gives 5.25 minus 1.5 = 3.75. Actual research, interpretation, full final checking and save/send retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage actual audiology office functions and finances.

steps.what: Review actual office workload, appointments, invoices and financial records
inputs: actual office/scheduling records
actual invoices, bank/accounting entries and budget
outputs: checked actual office and financial position

steps.what: Manage actual office priorities, staff coordination and financial exceptions
inputs: checked actual office and financial position
actual staff needs and unresolved financial issues
outputs: actual office decisions and chosen financial actions

steps.what: Prepare actual office or financial entry from verified source fields and chosen actions
inputs: actual office decisions and chosen financial actions
actual invoices and office source records

steps.what: Check full final office or financial entry, source, authority and destination
inputs: actual office/financial entry draft
actual office decisions and chosen financial actions
outputs: checked final actual entry and exact authorised destination

steps.what: Commit exact checked office or accounting entry to actual authorised record
inputs: checked final actual entry and exact authorised destination

tasks.design: Configure native office/financial views and source-backed entry fields in {OPS_SYSTEM}, {ERP} and {CALENDAR}. Retain actual management and exception decisions, with complete final entry checking before a separate authorised record commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Office and finance oversight can repeat view navigation and source-field copying.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and entry fields can reduce repeated administration.
tasks.still_hard: Office priorities, staff issues and financial exceptions require accountable decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The audiologist balances clinical service needs with office capacity and financial constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated office entry; management stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native practice and accounting views/fields can support office administration; they do not decide priorities or authorise financial transactions.

assumptions: Actual scheduling/office owners, invoice issuers and accounting/bank records produce source fields. Audiologist checks actual records in s1, chooses actions in s2 and captures any new decisions in retained s3. No real-time staffing status is assumed without its actual owner.

Entry routes are alternatives: office record in practice system or accounting entry in finance system, each with actual destination; not one cross-system transaction. S4 retains full source/amount/destination/authority checks. Actual payments, invoice sends or staff notices are distinct final-version gated actions, with no avoided labour claimed here.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Only actual audiologist management labour included, not staff/bookkeeper work. Native functions first; existing entry/prefill earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing final checking.
unknowns: Which office/accounting entry does the audiologist actually repeat?
research_questions: Can native views and fields reduce administration after complete source checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual office/financial source mappings and view access.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final office or accounting entry and its exact authorised destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.40 view navigation + 15*0.40 source-field entry = 16; minus 1 upkeep = 15. Half eligible gives 8 minus 1 = 7. Management, new decisions, full checking and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide public information on hearing or balance.

steps.what: Find and check actual approved public hearing/balance information for intended audience
inputs: actual public question or audience need
actual current approved hearing/balance texts

steps.what: Choose and explain appropriate hearing/balance information and answer actual audience questions
inputs: checked applicable public information sources
actual audience questions and understanding
outputs: actual chosen public explanation and identified information needs

steps.what: Prepare and check final written public information using chosen approved material
inputs: actual chosen public explanation and identified information needs
checked applicable public information sources
outputs: checked final public information and permitted publication/audience destination

steps.what: Save checked final public hearing/balance information draft
inputs: checked final public information and permitted publication/audience destination

steps.what: Publish or deliver exact checked public information to actual intended audience
inputs: checked final public information and permitted publication/audience destination

tasks.design: Configure native approved-material links and fixed public-information templates in {DOCS} and {CMS}. The audiologist chooses the explanation, retains actual questions and complete final material checking, then separately saves and publishes/delivers actual written information.
tasks.previous_blocker: Public education can repeat approved-source lookup and assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native approved-material links and fixed templates can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Audience understanding and distinction between general information and personal advice require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The audiologist recognises when a public question requires individual assessment rather than generic information.
tasks.altitude: Less information assembly; public explanation stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approved-source links and fixed templates can support public information; they do not assess hearing symptoms or determine personalised advice.

assumptions: Actual clinical/content owners supply current approved texts; audiologist checks source applicability and chooses explanation. Actual questions and understanding are produced in retained s2, not inferred from clicks.

S3 reduces fixed approved-section assembly only; new meaning, accessibility and complete clinical/omission checks remain. Actual written/publication branch only where used; oral-only provision removes it and reweights. Shared material prepared once per actual revision, not per attendee.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native functions first; existing materials/templates earn zero saving. Save/publication each retain one percent using existing checks. No individual diagnosis or autonomous medical advice proposed.
unknowns: Which public materials actually require repeated assembly?
research_questions: Can native approved sections reduce preparation after full clinical and accessibility checking?

incremental.description: Keep actual approved public materials and source links current.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final public information and exact draft destination; edits require recheck
s3 exact final public information, audience and authorised publication/delivery destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 lookup + 23*0.20 fixed-section assembly = 12.6; minus 1 upkeep = 11.6. Half eligible gives 6.3 minus 1 = 5.3. Actual explanation, new meaning, full check and save/publication retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop marketing plans and promote private audiology practice.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual practice services, audience evidence, capacity and previous marketing results
inputs: actual service offerings and practice capacity
actual consented audience/campaign records and costs

steps.what: Choose actual marketing objectives, audience, channels, claims and budget within practice capacity
inputs: checked actual marketing context
actual business objectives and permitted claims

steps.what: Draft actual marketing plan and promotional copy from chosen strategy and verified service facts
inputs: actual chosen marketing plan decisions
checked actual marketing context
outputs: source-linked actual plan and promotional copy draft

loop.purpose: Draft variable plan and copy prose from chosen strategy
loop.input: actual chosen objectives, services, budget and permitted claims
loop.output: source-linked plan and promotional copy draft
loop.check: Verify every service/outcome claim, costs, audience, exclusions and no unsupported treatment promises
loop.stop: Missing evidence or two failed checks requires manual copywriting
loop.why_not_simpler: Native plan/content templates first; variable promotional prose alone needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Check complete final plan/copy, truthful clinical claims, budget and actual publication authority
inputs: source-linked actual plan and promotional copy draft
actual chosen marketing plan decisions
outputs: checked final plan/copy and authorised channel/destination

steps.what: Save exact checked marketing plan and promotional copy
inputs: checked final plan/copy and authorised channel/destination

steps.what: Publish exact checked promotional copy through actual authorised practice channel
inputs: checked final plan/copy and authorised channel/destination

tasks.design: Configure native practice/campaign views in {CRM} and {BI}, then use templates and a bounded prose draft in {DOCS} and {CMS}. The audiologist retains marketing choices and complete clinical-claim/budget checking before separate save and actual promotional publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Practice promotion can repeat data retrieval and chosen-plan prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and bounded source-linked drafting can reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate claims, audience and service-capacity decisions require practice judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The audiologist avoids promises that exceed evidence or the service the practice can actually provide.
tasks.altitude: Less marketing administration; strategy and clinical claims stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native campaign views and source-linked drafting can assist practice marketing; they do not establish treatment claims, customer demand or marketing effectiveness.

assumptions: Actual practice/service owners produce capacity and service facts; actual campaign systems produce measured results, not assumed conversions. Audiologist checks sources and chooses strategy/budget in retained s1/s2.

S3 retains 15 provisional hours of new strategy capture and draft checking; s4 retains full final claim, audience, budget and publication checking. Only actual publication branch applies; plan-only work removes it and reweights. Paid campaign activation/spend, if actual, is a distinct final-budget/creative gated action with no avoided time claimed here.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native functions first; existing dashboard/draft capability earns zero new saving. Save/publication each retain one percent using existing checks. Shared general education material under 18683 counted once.
unknowns: Which marketing prose is actually newly prepared by the audiologist?
research_questions: Can native views and drafting reduce work after full clinical-claim and budget checks?

already_counted.description: New chosen-plan capture and draft checking retained in s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual service/claim sources and test faithful promotional drafting.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final plan/copy and exact practice draft destination; edits require recheck
s4 exact final promotional copy and authorised channel/audience; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 retrieval + 25*0.40 prose = 18; minus 1.5 upkeep = 16.5. Half eligible gives 9 minus 1.5 = 7.5. Actual strategy, new capture, complete final check and save/publication retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Audiologists retain research, management and public-information judgement while actual retrieval, entry and prose may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual repeated administration while retaining scientific and clinical responsibility and counting shared content once.
